order_note: Any time after SQL 91 (aws/workflows/sql/91_moov_onboarding.sql, applied to production 2026-10-19), and before Moov onboarding is used in production: SQL 91 added the policies aws_onboarding_insert_payment_idempotency_keys and aws_onboarding_update_payment_idempotency_keys but no table grant, so checksops gets "permission denied for table payment_idempotency_keys" before the policies are evaluated (#1062). SQL 104 grants SELECT, INSERT and UPDATE to checksops and authenticated and changes nothing else; SQL 91's file, pins and fingerprint (f8611dcc...) are unchanged. No later migration revokes these grants, so it is not re-run. Staging was granted by hand outside the guard per #1062, so its read-live is expected to report already_applied true (ops/production-sql-104-apply.md).

tooling.note: Guarded tooling for SQL 104: sql104-payment-idempotency-keys-grant-production-apply.mjs --inspect (read-only) and the receipt-gated --apply on the engine shared with the staging guarded executor (choice sql104-payment-idempotency-keys-grant); production-sql-one-shot.mjs --migration sql104. intended_replacement_sha256 is the code-derived fingerprint (releaseIntendedHash in release-sql-state.mjs, equal to the staging pin's): the SELECT, INSERT and UPDATE grants of checksops and authenticated on public.payment_idempotency_keys (spec table_privileges). The post-conditions also require every other grant on the table unchanged (other_table_privileges_unchanged) and the rest of the catalog unchanged. The tooling does not authorize anything: this pin stays execute false until a reviewed change records the staging acceptance, the production inspect and an owner approval.

staging_acceptance.basis: Pending: record the guarded staging SQL executor read-live run of SQL 104 (choice sql104-payment-idempotency-keys-grant), and the staging apply run if one is needed, here in the reviewed change that sets execute true. #1062 reports the same grant applied to staging by hand, outside the guard, so the read-live is expected to report already_applied true (live == intended) and the tools to refuse a staging apply as already in place; in that case the read-live is the staging evidence and the grant path itself is covered on PostgreSQL 16 by aws/tests/sql104-payment-idempotency-keys-grant-pg.test.mjs (from the table's original grants, SQL 104 through its production tool).
